ValidationRule.description: Branch Number (BSB/Sort Code/Routing Code) should be alphanumeric
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISPICKVAL(Type__c, 'Payment (EFT)') || ISPICKVAL(Type__c, 'Ticket Refund EFT'), NOT(ISBLANK(Branch_Number_BSB_Sort_Code__c)), NOT(REGEX(Branch_Number_BSB_Sort_Code__c, "^[A-Za-z0-9]+$")), ISCHANGED(Branch_Number_BSB_Sort_Code__c) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Branch Number (BSB/Sort Code/Routing Code) should be alphanumeric
